description: Add or change (pass id) an e-mail, phone number or address of a person. Required for new: contact_id, kind (email|phone|address), and value (email/phone) or street/postal_code/city (address). label: privat (default) | dienstlich | mobil | sonstig. is_primary marks the preferred one of its kind.

id.description: ID of the contact point to change; omit to create

is_primary.description: true = preferred entry of its kind

value.description: E-mail address or phone number (for kind email/phone)

name: upsert_contact_point
